meta.title: Highlight the device in the ZHA network visualization
meta.body:

## Proposed change
<!--
  Describe the big picture of your changes here to communicate to the
  maintainers why we should accept this pull request. If it fixes a bug
  or resolves a feature request, be sure to link to that issue or discussion
  in the additional information section.
-->

The "View network" button on the ZHA device page has done nothing since the ECharts rewrite (#25457), because the visualization page dropped the property the router sets. `ha-network-graph` now takes a `selectedNode`: the node gets a ring and a bold label, and the view centers on it, zoomed so its neighbors stay visible, until the user moves the view.

Depends on #55397: without it, turning physics off while the view follows a node leaves every label invisible.
